pins.head: ONE ROLL, HOW MANY DECALS
pins.title: Vinyl Roll Yield: How Many Decals a 12-Inch Roll Really Gives You
pins.desc: A 12-inch roll sounds generous until you lay the designs out. Work out how many decals fit across the width first, then multiply by the length you actually have, and keep a margin for weeding mistakes. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl, one sage green and one cream, resting on a wooden craft table beside a gridded cutting mat, loose sheets and a pencil, with daylight from a curtained window.

pins.head: GIVE THE BED ITS OWN WALL
pins.title: Studio Apartment Zones: Separating Sleeping and Sitting in One Room
pins.desc: One room does not have to read as one space. Put the bed against its own wall, turn a low shelf sideways as the divider, and let the rug under the sofa mark where the living zone starts. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A studio room with a bed under a teal blanket on the left, a low cube shelf used as a divider, a dark green sofa with an orange throw, a round wooden coffee table and a patterned rug.

pins.head: REFILL THE JAR, NOT THE SHELF
pins.title: Moisturizer Refills: When a Pouch Beats Buying the Jar Again
pins.desc: A refill pouch is usually cheaper per ounce, but only if you finish it before it turns. Match the pouch size to how much you actually use in a season, and keep one jar to decant into. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A bright bathroom counter beside a window with an open glass jar of cream, its lid set down next to it, a cream-colored refill pouch standing behind, and folded towels on a shelf.

pins.head: MEASURE THE TRAP, NOT THE DOOR
pins.title: Under-Sink Organizer Sizing: Measure Around the Plumbing First
pins.desc: The cabinet opening is not the constraint. The pipe is. Measure from the back wall to the trap, and from the floor to the lowest fitting, then pick an organizer that clears both instead of one that fits the doorway. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An open cabinet under a kitchen sink with white plastic drain pipes overhead, a yellow tape measure stretched across the cabinet floor and a pale green wire shelf standing at the right.

pins.head: A BAG IS TWELVE MORNINGS
pins.title: Whole-Bean Coffee, 12 oz: How Many Cups One Bag Actually Makes
pins.desc: At about 18 grams a cup, a 12-ounce bag is roughly eighteen mugs, so a bag a week suits two people who drink one each. Work out your own count before you commit to a subscription cadence. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A brown kraft coffee bag on a wooden counter with a small stack of coffee capsules in front of it, a calculator, a notepad and pencil, and a potted plant beside a bright window.

pins.head: THE CART GOES WHERE TILE ENDS
pins.title: Small Bathroom Storage With No Drilling: Hooks, Carts and Caddies
pins.desc: Renters lose the wall, not the storage. Over-the-door hooks take the towels, a narrow cart on wheels takes the spares, and the gap beside the toilet is usually wide enough for both. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A small bathroom with two coral towels hanging from over-the-door hooks on the left, a potted plant on the windowsill, and a teal rolling cart holding toiletries and spare toilet paper beside the toilet.

pins.head: STIR SLOW, POP THE BUBBLES
pins.title: Mixing Epoxy Resin With Fewer Bubbles: Slow Stir, Then Heat
pins.desc: Most bubbles are whipped in during mixing, not born in the resin. Stir slowly against the side of the cup, let the mix rest a few minutes, then pass heat over the surface once instead of chasing every bubble. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A hand stirring clear resin with a wooden stick in a plastic cup set on a black silicone mat, with a heat gun lying beside it on a wooden table near a window.

pins.head: THE SHELF ABOVE THE HANGERS
pins.title: Tiny Closet Organization for Renters: Use the Shelf Above the Rod
pins.desc: The rod is rarely the problem. The dead space above it is. Fabric bins turn that shelf into labeled storage for off-season clothes, and a low rack under the hems keeps shoes off the closet floor. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An open closet with fabric bins with handles lined up on the top shelf, clothes on wooden hangers below, and shoes arranged on a two-tier rack on the floor beside a navy dresser.

pins.head: FOUR TUBES, ONE DRAWER
pins.title: Toothpaste Multipacks: Buy the Count Your Drawer Can Hold
pins.desc: A three-pack is only cheaper if the spares have somewhere to live. Count how many tubes the drawer tray holds standing up, then buy to that number and keep the rest of the shelf for brush heads. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: An open wooden drawer with clear divided trays holding four white toothpaste tubes standing upright and a row of spare toothbrush heads in the next compartment.

pins.head: THE DOOR HOLDS THE COATS
pins.title: Renter-Friendly Storage: Doors, Tension Rods and Rolling Carts
pins.desc: Nothing here needs a drill. Over-the-door hooks carry coats and bags, a tension rod adds a second hanging line, and a slim cart rolls into the gap beside the closet. All of it leaves with you. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A closed door with over-the-door hooks holding a denim jacket, a shoulder bag and a mesh tote, with a teal three-tier rolling cart, woven baskets and a cushion in the corner beside it.

pins.head: STAND THE FOLDERS UPRIGHT
pins.title: A Wire File Sorter That Stands Paper Upright on a Small Desk
pins.desc: Paper piles because it lies flat. An upright wire sorter gives each project a slot you can read from the chair, and the open frame takes almost no desk depth on a narrow desk. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: A narrow wooden desk by a window with a black wire file sorter holding colored folders, a black mesh letter tray with a notebook and pen, a desk lamp, a small plant and a teal chair.

pins.head: PRIME GREY, PAINT ONCE
pins.title: Miniature Priming and Brush Basics: Why Grey Primer Saves a Coat
pins.desc: Grey primer shows the detail you are about to lose and keeps colors from needing two passes. Prime thin, let it cure fully, and start with a pointed round brush before reaching for anything finer. Contains affiliate links.
pins.alt: Three grey primed miniatures mounted on cork bases standing on a dark cutting mat, with two fine pointed brushes, a small potted succulent and a glass jar on a wooden table by a window.
